description: This file implements functions for an HTTP Simple Proxy object, including connection acceptance, removal, query processing, sync/async processing, send completion, and notification handling. It mainly manages server socket events, connection lifecycle, and session interactions within a proxy server environment.

methods.name: BOOL HttpSpoPubwoAccept(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,PANSC_HANDLE phClientContext)
methods.description: Handles accepting a new server connection, allocating buffer descriptor for incoming messages.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpSpoPubwoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket)
methods.description: Handles removal of a server connection, cleaning up associated session and socket contexts.

methods.name: ULONG HttpSpoPubwoQuery(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,PANSC_HANDLE phQueryContext)
methods.description: Processes incoming data buffer for a server connection, interacting with the session object to determine processing mode.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpSpoPubwoProcessSync(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hQueryContext)
methods.description: Processes data synchronously, forwarding it or receiving more from the server based on session state and query mode.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpSpoPubwoProcessAsync(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hQueryContext)
methods.description: Stub function for asynchronous processing which is currently not implemented.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpSpoPubwoSendComplete(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved,ANSC_STATUS status)
methods.description: Callback after send completes, currently a no-op.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpSpoPubwoNotify(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,ULONG ulEvent,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Handles socket events such as error, closed, resources, or timeout events, performing appropriate cleanup or session notification.
